messages.subject: Compiling Mondrian in Linux
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I've tried to compile Mondrian:
$ svn co svn://svn.rforge.net/org/trunk/rosuda
$ cd rosuda/
$ cd Mondrian/
$ make
and got errors:
rm -f *.class
jar fc MRJ.jar com
javac -encoding ISO-8859-1 -target 1.4 -source 1.4 -classpath MRJ.jar:.
Mondrian.java AboutBox.java Barchart.java DataListener.java DragBox.java
InteractionSet.java Map.java MFrame.java ModelListener.java
ModelNavigator.java Mosaic.java MyPoly.java MyRect.java MyText.java PC.java
PixelConsumer.java Qsort.java Selection.java SelectionListener.java
Stat.java Table.java Util.java Histogram.java Axis.java Query.java
Scatter2D.java dataSet.java PreferencesFrame.java Join.java Srs.java
../JRclient/jcrypt.java ../JRclient/RBool.java ../JRclient/Rconnection.java
../JRclient/REXP.java ../JRclient/RFactor.java
../JRclient/RFileInputStream.java ../JRclient/RFileOutputStream.java
../JRclient/RList.java ../JRclient/Rpacket.java
../JRclient/RSrvException.java ../JRclient/Rtalk.java
../util/ImageSelection.java DataEvent.java BufferTokenizer.java
SelectionEvent.java ../JRclient/RSession.java
Join.java:35: package org.rosuda.REngine does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.*;
^
Join.java:36: package org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve.*;
^
Join.java:88: cannot find symbol
symbol  : class RConnection
location: class Join
  private RConnection rC;
          ^
Map.java:10: package org.rosuda.REngine does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.*;
^
Map.java:11: package org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve.*;
^
Histogram.java:13: package org.rosuda.REngine does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.*;
^
Histogram.java:14: package org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve.*;
^
Scatter2D.java:11: package org.rosuda.REngine does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.*;
^
Scatter2D.java:12: package org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve.*;
^
Srs.java:1: package org.rosuda.REngine does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.*;
^
Srs.java:2: package org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve does not exist
import org.rosuda.REngine.Rserve.*;
^
make: *** [Mondrian.jar] Error 4


Please tell me what is wrong, because I really stuck there :)
I've also tried compile it with netbeans, however without converting Xcode
project file to netbeans it seems useless due to class duplicates.

Thanks in advance.
-- 
Regards,
Taras Klaskovsky
